elaine: Quick announcement: were rolling out a staggered phase-out of the legacy promotional free credits tied to early signups. This starts for new accounts created on or after 2026-08-01. :mega:

elaine: Rationale: the legacy credits program was generous but led to inconsistent unit economics. New program focuses on calibrated trial bundles + usage-based coupons. This is a billing policy change, not a rate-limit or quota change.

devon: TL;DR on mechanics?

elaine: - New accounts from 2026-08-01 get a fixed trial bundle (e.g., $50 hosted credits for 30 days) rather than the old rolling credit model.
  - Existing accounts created before 2026-08-01 are grandfathered at current credit terms for 12 months.
  - After 12 months well transition grandfathered accounts to the new trial bundle on their next annual renewal unless they opt into a partner or startup exception.

billing-bot: Example line item for new-account trial:
```
Invoice period: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31
Hosted usage: 120,000 tokens ($12.00)
Trial bundle applied: -$50.00 (expires 2026-08-31)
Amount due: $0.00 (usage covered by trial)
```

tasha: What about startups and incubator partners that relied on the old credits?

partners-lead: We're creating a partner-managed credit program. Partners can opt to issue top-up credits via partner portal; these are separate from the platform trial and show as partner adjustments on invoices. Partners must opt-in by 2026-07-15 for grandfathering exceptions.

devon: How will this appear on invoices and UI?

elaine: Invoices will show: "Promotional credit: <source>" with expiration dates. Billing UI will add a filter for 'grandfathered credits' and a transition status flag. Finance will surface an "expiry calendar" for credits older than 9 months.

legal: We added a T&Cs paragraph: "Promotional credit programs may be modified or phased out with at least 30 days' notice; grandfathering timelines are provided for existing credits." Don't promise indefinite credits to customers.

support: We'll need macros. Draft macro: "Were updating our promotional credit program. Tickets relating to credit expiry or invoice adjustments should include account ID and invoice number. If your account was created before 2026-08-01 you may be eligible for grandfathered terms for up to 12 months; please include your org creation date in replies."

devon: Edge cases: consolidated billing (orgs with multiple subaccounts) will continue to have credits at the org level. We'll add an internal flag for "org-level grandfathering". Reseller partner credits are opt-in as partners-lead described.

partners-lead: For channel partners selling through resellers: well run a webinar on partner credit flows next Wed. I'll post the slide deck and partner-portal spec.

elaine: Customer communications plan: 1) Email to grandfathered customers 30 days before their credits expire; 2) Dashboard banner for affected accounts 45 days prior; 3) Support macros + CS playbook.

billing-bot: Example notification payload (internal):
```
acct: acct_2026_old
credit_balance: $120.00
grant_date: 2025-11-02
grandfather_expiry: 2026-11-02 (auto-transition unless opted-out)
```

devon: Finance ops: prepare scripts to identify accounts with credits > 90 days and flag for outreach. We'll also run a one-off reconciliation for credits that would have expired but were used after our notice window.

support: Expect increased ticket volume in first 60 days. I'll allocate two more agents and schedule office hours with finance during the first week after notice sends.

elaine: Any objections? If no blockers well ship the FAQ + email copy by EOD Thursday and schedule the banner rollout next Tuesday.

legal: FYI: for enterprise contracts with explicit credit clauses, don't change terms unilaterally; sales must coordinate amendments.

tasha: Can we add a small retention incentive for affected customers (e.g., one-time 10% off coupon on first paid invoice)?

devon: We can pilot a targeted coupon for churn-risk accounts. Finance will approve a budget and reporting requirements.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll post the canonical doc and customer-facing templates in the product bulletin. Tag me on any exceptions. :pray:
